blocks.en: Aggregation across seeds
blocks.zh: 不同种子的聚合

blocks.en: The language-likeness score was first computed at the seed level. Scores were then averaged across seeds for each unique parameter combination. Parameter combinations were ranked by their mean language-likeness score across seeds. This aggregation reduced sensitivity to a single favorable stochastic realization.
blocks.zh: 语言相似度分数首先在种子一级计算出. 然后,每个独特的参数组合的种子平均得分。 参数组合按其不同种子的平均语言性分数排列。 这种聚合降低了对单一偏好分解的敏感性。

blocks.en: Parameter selection
blocks.zh: 参数选择

blocks.en: We first retained the top 10% of parameter combinations ranked by mean language-likeness score. We then excluded any combination for which one or more seeds failed the quality-control criteria. This procedure retained a high-performing region of the parameter space rather than relying only on a single best parameter combination. The best parameter set was specifically picked up for later analysis.
blocks.zh: 我们首先保留了按照平均语言类分数排名的前10%参数组合. 然后,我们排除了一种或多种种子未能达到质量控制标准的任何组合。 这一程序保留了参数空间的一个高性能区域,而不是仅仅依赖单一的最佳参数组合. 最佳参数集被具体取出用于后期分析.

blocks.en: Simulation evaluation
blocks.zh: 模拟评价

blocks.en: Model family comparison
blocks.zh: 示范家庭比较

blocks.en: Figure 7 showed that different pressure components contributed to different aspects of language-like organization. Dependency-distance metrics were strongly affected by model family, including exponential fit, power-law fit, and the combined dependency-decay score. Models containing DLT-inspired structural costs outperformed the surprisal-only model on these dependency-based measures, indicating that structural pressure was the main driver of broad sequence-level organization. Lexical distribution metrics also differed across model families. Adding contextual surprisal to the structural model did not significantly improve the overall language-likeness score relative to the DLT-only model, but it improved the Zipf-related lexical profile, including the rank-frequency fit and Zipf-score components. Thus, structural costs primarily supported dependency-like organization and overall language-likeness, whereas surprisal contributed more specifically to the lexical-statistical structure of the generated sequences. For all measures, omnibus differences were tested using Kruskal–Wallis tests, followed by Dwass–Steel–Critchlow–Fligner pairwise comparisons.
blocks.zh: 图7显示,不同的压力成分促成了语言类组织的不同方面。 依赖-距离的衡量标准受到模范家庭的严重影响,包括指数适中、权力法适中和依赖-decay综合得分。 含有受DLT启发的结构成本的模型在这些基于依赖的计量上超过了仅次于超额的模型,表明结构压力是广义序列级组织的主要驱动力. 示范家庭的表征分布指标也各不相同。 在结构模型中加入上下文外观并没有比起 DLT 唯一模式显著地改善整体语言相似度分数,但它改进了与Zipf相關的Lexical profile,包括分级频率相适应和Zipf分数相關的分數. 因此,结构成本主要支持类似依赖性的组织和整体语言性,而补充成本更具体地促进了生成序列的词汇统计结构。 对所有措施来说,采用克罗斯卡尔-瓦利斯(Kruskal-Wallis)测试了总括差异,其次是德瓦斯-斯泰尔-克里奇洛-弗利克纳对等比较。

blocks.en: Parameter effects on language-like score
blocks.zh: 对语言类分数的参数效果

blocks.en: We next used a descriptive marginal analysis to visualize how individual parameters were associated with language-likeness across the scanned parameter space. This analysis was not intended to estimate the independent causal effect of each parameter. Instead, it summarized which regions of the parameter space tended to produce more language-like simulated sequences. In Figure 8 , each point shows the mean language-likeness score for simulations sharing a given parameter value, computed separately for each model family and averaged over the remaining parameters.
blocks.zh: 接下来我们用一个描述性边际分析来可视化单个参数如何与被扫描参数空间的语言相似性相关. 这一分析无意估计每个参数的独立因果关系。 相反,它总结了参数空间的哪些区域倾向于产生更多类似语言的模拟序列。 在图8中,每个点都显示用于分享特定参数值的模拟的平均语言相似度分数,为每个模型家族分别计算,并按所余参数进行平均值.

blocks.en: Language-likeness was not controlled by a single parameter. The boundary threshold θ \theta had only a modest effect, with scores remaining relatively stable across the tested threshold range. Pressure carry-over ρ \rho showed a clearer positive association, especially in the DLT-only family, indicating that some persistence of accumulated pressure helped generate more structured sequence organization rather than purely local boundary fluctuations.
blocks.zh: 语言相似性没有被单个参数所控制. 边界阈值 \\theta 的影响不大,在测试阈值范围内的分数仍然相对稳定。 承接的压力表明一种更明确的积极联系,特别是在仅属于DLT的家族中,表明某些累积压力的持续存在有助于产生更结构化的序列组织,而不是纯粹的局部边界起伏.

blocks.en: Context strength β ctx \beta_{\mathrm{ctx}} showed a nonlinear profile. Scores increased from weak to moderate context strength, but declined when contextual constraint became too strong, most clearly in the surprisal-only family. This suggests that contextual information was beneficial only within a bounded range: weak context provided little structure, whereas overly strong context could make lexical sampling too constrained and reduce the balance of the generated sequences.
blocks.zh: 上下文强度 β ctx\ββ mathrm{ctx} 显示非线性配置 。 得分从弱到温和的环境强度增加,但当环境约束变得过强时却有所下降,最明显的是,在仅限支配家庭。 这表明,背景信息只有在一定的范围内才有益:薄弱的背景提供了很少的结构,而过于紧密的背景则可能使词典抽样过于受限并减少生成序列的平衡。

blocks.en: Baseline opening and closure tendencies also shaped language-likeness. Opening tendency showed relatively weak effects in the DLT-containing families, whereas closure tendency showed a more consistently positive association. This pattern suggests that allowing relations to close at an appropriate rate helped maintain plausible dependency-like organization, preventing relations from remaining unresolved for too long.

blocks.en: The DLT-specific parameters showed the most stable associations with language-likeness. Higher total DLT strength, defined as a mem + b int a_{\mathrm{mem}}+b_{\mathrm{int}} , was associated with higher scores in both DLT-containing families. The separate memory and integration weights also showed positive associations, with integration cost b int b_{\mathrm{int}} displaying the clearest monotonic increase. blocks.en: Completion-only control model
blocks.zh: 仅完成控制模式

blocks.en: To isolate the contribution of pressure-dependent boundary gating, we constructed a completion-only control using the same generative framework and parameters as the selected pressure-driven model (SI, Table S 3 ). Both models generated sequences through four possible operations: emitting an ordinary token ( X X ), opening a dependency-like relation ( O O ), closing an existing relation ( C C ), or emitting a segment boundary ( B B ). Boundaries were permitted only when all open relations had been resolved. The models differed in how boundaries and subsequent continuation events were selected at these structurally permissible positions.
blocks.zh: 为了隔离依赖压力的分界线地标的作用,我们用与选定的压力驱动模型相同的基因框架和参数(SI,表S 3 )构建了一个只完成的控制. 这两个模型通过四种可能的操作产生序列:出出一个普通的令牌(X X),打开一个类似依赖关系(O O),关闭一个已存在的关系(C C),或出出出一个分边界(B B). 只有在所有开放关系得到解决时,才允许划定边界。 在这些结构上允许的位置如何选择界限和随后的延续事件方面,模型各不相同。

blocks.en: Sentence length distribution
blocks.zh: 刑期分配

blocks.en: The intervals between actual sentence boundaries showed a strongly right-skewed distribution with a long tail (Figure 9 ). Most boundaries occurred after relatively short-to-intermediate token spans, with the highest density around the typical sentence-length range, whereas a smaller number of intervals extended far into a long right tail.
blocks.zh: 实际句子边界之间的间隔显示有很强的右向滑行分布并有很长的尾巴(图9. 大多数边界发生在相对短到中间的符号跨度后,在典型的句长范围周围密度最高,而较小的间隔会被延伸到很长的右尾.

blocks.en: Completion-only model comparison
blocks.zh: 仅完成模型比较

blocks.en: To evaluate the contribution of pressure-dependent boundary gating, we compared the pressure-driven model with a completion-only control using 500 paired random seeds. The two models produced approximately matched mean segment lengths (21.57 ± \pm 1.37 vs. 22.04 ± \pm 1.74 tokens, mean ± \pm standard deviation across seeds). Despite their similar mean lengths, the models differed substantially in their segment-length distributions (Figure 10 A). Pressure-driven segmentation showed lower length variability, with a standard deviation of 14.21 compared with 18.51 in the completion-only model ( t ⁡ ( 499 ) = − 33.60 t(499)=-33.60 , p < 0.001 p<0.001 ). The difference persisted after normalization by mean length, with coefficients of variation of 0.657 and 0.840, respectively ( t ⁡ ( 499 ) = − 44.07 t(499)=-44.07 , p < 0.001 p<0.001 ). The pressure-driven model also exhibited greater positive skewness (2.18 vs. 1.64, t ⁡ ( 499 ) = 20.26 t(499)=20.26 , p < 0.001 p<0.001 ).
blocks.zh: 为了评价以压力为依归的边界地标的作用,我们用500对随机种子来比较由压力驱动的模型和只完成的控制. 两种型号生产出大约相匹配的平均段长(21.57±\pm 1.37对22.04±\pm 1.74令牌,指±\pm标准差跨种子). 尽管其平均长度相似,但模型的分长分布差别很大(图10 A)。 由压力驱动的分化显示长度可变性较低,标准偏差为14.21,而仅完成模式中的为18.51(t-(499)=-33.60t(499)=-33.60,p < 0.001p < 0.001). 正常化后,按平均长度计算,差异持续存在,差异系数分别为0.657和0.840(t-(499)=-44.07t(499)=-44.07,p < 0.001p < 0.001). 压力驱动模式还表现出了更强的正斯克维度(2.18对 1.64,t-(499)=20.26t(499)=20.26,p < 0.001 p < 0.001)。

blocks.en: The models achieved comparable overall language-likeness scores (2.652 vs. 2.649, p = 0.432 p=0.432 ). The completion-only model showed a slightly higher dependency-decay score (0.888 vs. 0.883, p < 0.001 p<0.001 ), whereas the pressure-driven model showed a slightly higher Zipf score (0.769 vs. 0.760, p = 0.007 p=0.007 ). Thus, both mechanisms reproduced the broad statistical properties included in the language-likeness criterion, despite generating different segment-length distributions.
blocks.zh: 这些模型取得了可比较的整体语言类分数(2.652 vs 2.649, p = 0.432 p = 0.432). 完成唯能模型显示的依赖性十进制分数略高(0.888 vs. 0.883, p < 0.001 p < 0.001 ),而压力驱动模型显示的Zipf分数略高(0.769 vs. 0.760, p = 0.007 p= 0.007). 因此,两种机制都转载了语言类分数标准中包含的广泛统计属性,尽管产生了不同的分长分布.

blocks.en: The comparable overall language-likeness scores partly reflected offsetting differences in their component measures: the completion-only model showed slightly better dependency-length decay, while the pressure-driven model showed a better fit to Zipf-like lexical distributions. Despite similar aggregate scores, the models exhibited distinct boundary-aligned processing dynamics (Figure 10 B–E). In the pressure-driven model, accumulated pressure increased toward boundary emission, accompanied by a pronounced decline in memory cost and a sharp increase in integration cost immediately before closure. The completion-only model showed a weaker decline in memory cost and a substantially smaller pre-boundary integration peak. Lexical surprisal also followed different pre-boundary trajectories but converged to similar profiles after boundary emission. Both models exhibited post-boundary resets, as specified by their shared generative framework. Together, these results indicate that pressure-dependent gating contributes to the organization of segment lengths and boundary-centered processing dynamics beyond structural completion alone.
blocks.zh: 相似语言的可比总体分数部分反映了其成份测量的相抵差异:只完成模型显示的依赖长衰减略好,而由压力驱动模型显示的则更适合Zipf相似的词汇分布. 尽管总得分相似,但这些模型显示了不同的边界相接加工动态(图10 B-E)。 在由压力驱动的模型中,累积的压力对边界排放增加,同时内存成本明显下降,关闭前的集成成本急剧上升. 仅完成的模型显示内存成本下降较弱,边界前整合峰值大幅降低. exprisal也遵循不同的前边界轨迹,但在边界排放后与相类似的剖面相汇合. 这两个模型都显示了其共同基因框架所指明的后边界重现。 这些结果加在一起表明,依赖压力的标注有助于将分段长度和以边界为中心的加工动态组织在结构完成之外。

blocks.en: Robustness of processing-cost effects on boundary judgments
blocks.zh: 处理成本对边界判决的影响的力度

blocks.en: To examine whether the observed associations were driven by structurally defined unit endings, we repeated the analysis after excluding 300 annotated top-level unit-ending positions (Figure 11 ). All three processing costs retained their directions and statistical significance: memory cost after the current word (OR = 0.739, 95% CI [0.691, 0.791], p < 0.001 p<0.001 ), integration cost (OR = 1.088, 95% CI [1.022, 1.159], p = 0.008 p=0.008 ), and semantic mismatch (OR = 1.170, 95% CI [1.099, 1.245], p < 0.001 p<0.001 ). Adding these predictors continued to improve model fit beyond grammatical and prosodic controls ( Δ \Delta AIC = − 1,101.02 -1,101.02 ; joint Wald p < 0.001 p<0.001 ), indicating that their associations with boundary choices were not restricted to top-level unit endings.
blocks.zh: 为了审查所观察到的关联是否由结构界定的单位终点所驱动,我们重复了分析,在排除300个附加说明的高级单位终点职位之后(图11)。 所有三种处理成本都保留了方向和统计意义:当前单词后的内存成本(OR=0.739,95% CI [0.691,0.791],p < 0.001],集成成本(OR=1.088,95% CI [1.022,1.159],p=0.008 p=0.008),语义不匹配(OR=1.170,95% CI [1.099,1.245],p < 0.001]),添加这些预测器继续改进了适合语法和Prosodic控制以外的模型(Δ\Delta AIC = 1,101.02-1,101.02;联合Wald p < 0.001,p < 0.001),表明其与边界选择的联系不仅限于顶级单位结束。

blocks.en: We further tested whether these associations depended on how grammatical structure was represented. Replacing the numeric grammar predictor with a categorical specification yielded similar effects for memory cost (OR = 0.711, 95% CI [0.665, 0.761], p < 0.001 p<0.001 ), integration cost (OR = 1.092, 95% CI [1.033, 1.154], p = 0.002 p=0.002 ), and semantic mismatch (OR = 1.159, 95% CI [1.099, 1.223], p < 0.001 p<0.001 ; Figure 12 ). The three predictors also improved model fit under this alternative specification ( Δ \Delta AIC = − 1,362.31 -1,362.31 ; joint Wald p < 0.001 p<0.001 ). These analyses indicate that the relationships between processing costs and perceived boundaries were robust to the exclusion of structurally defined endings and to alternative grammatical coding.
blocks.zh: 我们进一步检验了这些联系是否取决于语法结构的代表性。 以绝对规格取代数字语法预测器对内存成本(OR = 0.711,95% CI [0.665, 0.761],p < 0.001 p<0.001]),集成成本(OR = 1.092,95% CI [1.033, 1.154],p=0.002 p=0.002)和语义不匹配(OR = 1.159,95% CI [1.099, 1.223],p < 0.001 p<0.001;图12)产生了类似的效果。三种预测器还改进了符合这一替代规格的模型(Δ\Delta AIC = − 1,362.31-1,362.31;联合Wald p < 0.001 p < 0.001)) 。 这些分析表明,加工成本与所感知的边界之间的关系与排除结构定义的结尾和替代语法编码是牢固的。

blocks.en:
Figure 13: Sentence-boundary sensitivity differs across human behavioral and LLM representational measures.
For each outcome, the plot shows the z z value associated with the sentence-boundary coefficient from an ordinary least-squares regression model controlling for pressure-derived predictors, word position, and item fixed effects, with cluster-robust standard errors at the sentence level. Lines extend from zero to the estimated boundary effect. Positive values indicate increased outcome values at sentence boundaries, whereas negative values indicate decreased outcome values at sentence boundaries. Reading-time residuals and LLM local intrinsic dimensionality increased at boundaries, while LLM surprisal, cosine update, trajectory curvature, and layer-curvature measures decreased at boundaries. Reported P FDR P_{\mathrm{FDR}} values are corrected across outcomes using False Discovery Rate (FDR).

图13:不同人类行为和LLM代表度的量刑敏感性不同。
对于每个结果,地圖会从普通的最小平方回归模型控制出由压力产生的预测器,词位,和项目固定效应,显示与句子边界系数相联的z z值,在句子级别上有集群-robust标准错误. 线由零延伸至估计边界效应. 正值表示句子边界上的结果值增加,而负值表示句子边界上的结果值减少. 读取时间残存和 LLM 本地内在维度在边界上增加,而 LLM 超相感应,相声更新,轨迹曲率,地层曲率测量在边界上减少. 所报告的PDR P_{\-mathrm{FDR}}-用假发现率(FDR)对结果进行校正.
